speaker: (the clerk)
text: A coast. No town in it. That is the whole of the copy I was given.

speaker: richard_field
text: Read no further. If it will not name a place, I will not have it improved.

speaker: john_harrison
text: The sheet on the stall names a day, and it will sell.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have read the day, standing. Thursday the 24 of July. I have not turned the leaf, and I am not buying it.

speaker: (the grocer)
text: If they can burn Cornwall unopposed then the Armada is not dead history but only resting.

speaker: john_harrison
text: It will sell.

speaker: richard_field
text: Let the unsold sentence stay a sentence. The letter has no town. That is the news I came out for.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two stories, in one breath. Thursday, and a Spaniard ashore somewhere in Cornwall. Nobody can say where.

speaker: (the clerk)
text: I can read the copy again. It will not grow a town by being read twice.

speaker: john_harrison
text: The quire you came for is fivepence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fivepence. I will have the quire. I will not have the sheet.

speaker: (the grocer)
text: Cornwall is a where. You want a parish, and the road has not brought one.

speaker: richard_field
text: Then we wait for a parish. I will not invent one beside a stall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard bells yesterday and did not go down for an account. I will not have this leaf turned for me either.

speaker: john_harrison
text: The sheet will sell to men who are not you. The quire is fivepence either way.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fivepence. The words I read are the date, and the imprint, and no more.

speaker: (the clerk)
text: Printed by Allde for Blackwall. You have that off the sheet. My copy is the letter, and the letter is blank of towns.

speaker: richard_field
text: Blank of towns is what I came to hear. I have heard it.

speaker: (the grocer)
text: Resting, I said. Not dead. The pillar can keep the sentence if you will not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The pillar may keep it. I am for the last play before the break, with both stories still knotted.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Your quire. Fivepence, and nothing off the other stall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing off the other stall.

speaker: richard_field
text: Knot them if you must. Do not ask me which knot is the true one.

speaker: (the grocer)
text: Unopposed. That is the word I have. I have not got a better.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I have a quire, and a date, and a coast with no name.
